title.narrative: Entrepreneurship and Skills Training for Ivorian Refugees and Host Communities to Strengthen Resilience and Improve Livelihoods in Grand Gedeh Country, Liberia

description.narrative: The project endeavors to provide Ivorian refugees and host communities who are farmers in Grand Gedeh County, located at the border between Liberia and Cote d#Ivoire, an access to rural livelihoods to increase socio-economic resilience. It will build on their strengths as a farming community by conducting entrepreneurship and skills training as a key intervention. The training will equip them with skills and business culture aiming to increase productivity and add value to the agricultural outputs, thereby raising incomes and employment as well as food security.The project will facilitate the establishment of self-help groups amongst the beneficiaries. These selfhelp initiatives will address their common problems such as accessing land and agricultural inputs, need for post-harvest facilities, collective marketing, etc. The intervention will develop productive and human capacities that will enhance productivity and development contributing towards inclusive and sustainable development in the region.
